result.summary: Fixed the typo in the executor graph-building comment in /workspace/src/Processors/Executors/ExecutingGraph.cpp line 74: "Add direct edges form output ports." now reads "Add direct edges from output ports.", matching the parallel back-edge comment above it. No runtime behavior changed; verified this was the only occurrence of the "edges form" typo in src/ and programs/.

The docs tree was fully pruned from this snapshot, so I created the canonical upstream page /workspace/docs/en/sql-reference/functions/array-functions.md with the usual slug/sidebar frontmatter and an `arrayWithConstant` reference entry (description, syntax, arguments, returned value/type, and a worked example matching the function's behaviour in src/Functions/array/arrayWithConstant.cpp).

Expanded /workspace/utils/antlr/README.md with a "What is this?" section explaining that the directory holds the ClickHouse SQL dialect grammar in ANTLR4 form (not used by the server, which parses via src/Parsers) and asking contributors to keep it in sync. Also added antlr4 installation guidance, fixed the stale `cd src/Parsers/New` path to `cd utils/antlr`, documented targeting other languages via -Dlanguage, and added a "How to check the grammar" section using antlr4-parse. Docs-only change; no runtime or SQL behavior touched.

Fixed the misspelled help text for the `kafka_handle_error_mode` Kafka engine setting in /workspace/src/Storages/Kafka/KafkaSettings.h, changing "Passible values: default, stream." to "Possible values: default, stream.". This was the sole occurrence of the typo in the tree; the setting name, type, default, and accepted enum values are unchanged.
